text_snippet: > ## Documentation Index > Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.qoder.com/llms.txt > Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further. # Qoder 1024 · Community Boost Join the community, boost daily, and unlock more SOTA Credits together. During the promotion, eligible individual Qoder users can claim a **Welcome Pack of 1,024 SOTA Credits** and contribute daily boosts to unlock additional **SOTA Credit Packs** together. Promotional Credits can be used with the **Sonus model**. More rewards await—let’s unlock them together. [Go to the event page](https://qoder.com/community-boost) All times in this article are in UTC+8. ## Rewards at a Glance | Reward | Unlock requirement | Credits | | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------ | | Welcome Pack | Join Community Boost | 1,024 SOTA Credits | | Round 1 SOTA Credit Pack | Reach 20,000 cumulative community boost points | 2,048 SOTA Credits | | Round 2 SOTA Credit Pack | Reach 50,000 cumulative community boost points | 3,072 SOTA Credits | | Round 3 SOTA Credit Pack | Reach 100,000 cumulative community boost points | 4,096 SOTA Credits | See the [event page](https://qoder.com/community-boost) for the boost targets and rewards for subsequent rounds. ## Promotion Details **Promotion period:** October 22, 2026 through October 30, 2026 at 23:59. Applications, application reviews, enrollment, boosting, and reward claims all close when the promotion ends. ### Join Community Boost - **Individual subscribers on Pro or higher:** You are automatically enrolled in Community Boost. Users who subscribe to or upgrade to Pro or higher during the promotion are also eligible. - **Lite subscribers:** Lite does not currently support Sonus, the model covered by these promotional Credit Packs. Upgrade to Pro or higher to claim rewards. - **Free users:** Submit an application on the event page. You will join Community Boost once your application is approved. Each account may apply only once. Applications cannot be edited or resubmitted after submission. Deploying a project with Qoder Sites and submitting your work can improve your chances of approval. - **Claim eligibility:** Eligibility is determined at the time of claiming. Your account must be on an individual Pro plan or higher, or be a Free account with an approved application for this promotion. - **Claim limits:** Each account may claim the Welcome Pack and each round’s SOTA Credit Pack once. ### Boost now 1. Community Boost members can click **Boost now** on the event page once per day. Each valid boost contributes 1 boost point. 2. Boosts count toward the current round’s progress and the cumulative community total. Reaching a round’s target unlocks its corresponding reward. Each round can be unlocked only once. SOTA Credit Packs will be issued within 12 hours of unlocking. Check the supported clients to confirm when they are available to claim. 3. Your daily boost resets at 00:00. Unused boosts do not accumulate or carry over. 4. Once the current round’s target is reached, the next round begins if there is one. The cumulative community total does not reset. You can claim an unlocked pack during its claim window as long as you are eligible at the time of claiming. You do not need to have boosted that day. Users who join or receive application approval after a round is unlocked can also claim its pack while the claim window remains open. ## Claiming and Using Your Rewards ### Claim Windows and Credit Validity | Credit Pack | Claim window | Usage validity | | ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | | Welcome Pack | Until October 30, 2026 at 23:59 | Until October 31, 2026 at 23:59 | | Each round’s SOTA Credit Pack | Within 3 days of issuance, but no later than October 30, 2026 at 23:59 | 24 hours from the time you claim it | If a pack is issued less than 3
